sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/340 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place, search/grid and search/details for facilities 390 Beaver Creek Campground, 391 Equestrian Camp, 392 Group Camp; all units on 2027-06-15, samples on 2027-06-19 and 2026-11-10, read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Closes Nov. 1, 2026 for substantial improvements, including a new shower house; no reopening date published. ReserveOhio blocks every site on the November, January and March dates checked.

status.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/beaver-creek-state-park-campground ('The campground closes Nov. 1st for substantial improvements', Campground Updates, October 2026) + ReserveOhio search/grid facility 390 on 2026-11-10, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 (IsBlocked), read 2026-10-31

values.note: $23 a night without electric, electric $33, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak prices shown for November are $19/$29. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details facility 390, 2027-06-15 and Sat 2027-06-19 (Campsite Non-Electric 23.00, Campsite Electric 33.00, Fee 6.50), 2026-11-10 (19.00 / 29.00), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details facility 390 (Electricity Hookup 50 on all six electric sites; no water or sewer hookup attribute) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/beaver-creek-state-park-campground ('6 electric sites', 'Camper fill Station'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Family campground on Leslie Road: 6 electric sites (pads 29-37 ft) and 39 non-electric (25-60 ft), all back-in gravel. Two Sherman cabins sit in the campground. The 59-site horse camp and tent-only group camp are on Sprucevale Road.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/beaver-creek-state-park-campground ('6 electric sites', '39 non-electric sites') + ReserveOhio search/details for all 45 units (Maximum Camping Unit Length, Pad Surface, Back In), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/beaver-creek-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months ahead online or by calling (866) 644-6727'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Pit toilets and no shower house (one is being built). Dump station stays open Nov. 1 to May 1 but without water.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/beaver-creek-state-park-campground ('Pit toilets', 'No showerhouse', 'Dump station, Camper fill Station', 'Construction of a new shower house', 'From Nov. 1 to May 1, dump station is available but there is no water'), read 2026-10-31

note: A one-lane bridge on Echo Dell Road can't take RVs; reach the park office from the south. --Claude
summary: $23/$33 confirmed; CLOSES Nov 1, 2026 for improvements, no reopening date (status set); 45 sites, 50-amp on six, pit toilets, dump; horse camp not part of this entry.
flags: CLOSURE: ODNR, October 2026: 'The campground closes Nov. 1st for substantial improvements.' That is tomorrow. No reopening date anywhere; ReserveOhio blocks all sites on 11/10, 1/12 and 3/16, and May 2027 onward isn't in the booking window yet. June 2027 rates are still quoted, so that isn't evidence it's open then.

SEASON left unset: ODNR's 'Off-Peak Season: From Nov. 1 to May 1, dump station is available but there is no water' implies year-round in normal years but doesn't say so, and this winter's closure overrides it.
PHONE missing: ODNR campground page gives (330) 385-3091.

HORSE CAMP, no split: the equestrian camp on Sprucevale Road is ~3.9 km SE (centroid 40.7135,-80.5817), own road. ReserveOhio: 64 units, ODNR: 59; 'This site is designated for persons camping with horses', so it doesn't qualify on its own.
Pin fine: 185 m from the site centroid 40.7298,-80.6219. Stored not waterfront stands: the sites sit on a wooded loop, Little Beaver Creek ~350 m SE per imagery.
